question: In the year 2022, Arjun Singh Dhurve was conferred the Padma Shri for his contribution to which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Baiga Tribal Dance**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Arjun Singh Dhurve was conferred the Padma Shri in 2022 for his contribution to the Baiga dance form of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Baiga dance form is a traditional dance form of the Baiga tribe, which is an indigenous community residing in the central Indian state of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The dance form is characterized by its unique costumes, music, and movements, which depict the daily life and culture of the Baiga tribe.
 
• Arjun Singh Dhurve is a renowned Baiga dancer and has been actively promoting and preserving the Baiga dance form for over two decades.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chhau****​**

 
 
• Chau or Chhau is a semi-classical Indian dance with martial, tribal, and folk origins from Orissa, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, and WestBengal.
 
• Chhau Dance is a popular form of tribal dance in India that incorporates elements of martial arts into its movements.
 
• This form of dance is a means to portray stories to the audience, which is why elaborate masks and headgear associated with battle and war are worn during the performance.
 
• It enacts episodes from epics including the Mahabharata and Ramayana, local folklore, and abstract themes.
 
• Over a century old, this dance form was widely endorsed by patrons belonging to the royal families, rich landlords, and British governors in the region.
 
 
 
• **Kathak**
 
 
• Kathak is one of the eight major classical dance forms of India and originated in North India.
 
• The dance form has its roots in the Mughal era and is characterized by intricate footwork, graceful hand movements, and storytelling through facial expressions.
 
• Kathak is closely associated with Hindustani classical music and is often performed to the accompaniment of tabla, sarangi, and sitar.
 
• The nineteenth century saw the golden age of Kathak under the patronage of Wajid Ali Shah, the last Nawab of Oudh.
 
• He established the Lucknow Gharana with its strong accent on bhava, the expression of moods and emotions.
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam ****​**
 
 
• Bharatanatyam originated in Tamil Nadu.
 
• Bharatanatyam is the oldest Indian classical dance and it originated hundreds of years ago in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu.
 
• This dance form expresses the religious themes and spiritual ideas of South India.
 
• The ancient Tamil epic Silappatikaram contains the description of Bharatanatyam.
